items.name: Daisy Lane: Print and Book Artist Residency
items.shortDescription: Daisy Lane is a newly renovated, light-filled space where artists can create and explore in a focused environment. The central program at Daisy Lane will be a year-round dedicated artist residency for artists working in book arts, letterpress, screenprinting, Risograph, and other related art forms.

items.name: 2027 Artist Residencies at Alchemy Art Center
items.shortDescription:
Alchemy Art Center hosts a seasonal artist residency program on San Juan Island, WA with a focus on artists working in the mediums of ceramics, printmaking, fiber art, or darkroom photography. Read more about this opportunity here.

2027 Program Dates:

Cohort 1: Teaching focus:
May 1st - June 9th, 2027
 

Cohort 2: Community Art focus: 
June 13th - July 21st, 2027
 

Cohort 3: Community Art focus: 
July 25th - September 8th, 2027

items.name: The World: Through Rose Colored Glasses
items.shortDescription:
Call for Entry: The World: Through Rose Colored Glasses

“We invite artists from all disciplines to interpret the theme ‘Through Rose Colored Glasses.’ How do we see the world—through hope, nostalgia, love, or idealism? What lies beyond the surface of our perceptions? This exhibition seeks works that explore the boundaries between optimism and reality, adoration and critique, and the ways we navigate society’s pressures with creativity and heart.”

Entries Due: December 1, 2026 
Exhibition Dates: January 22 – February 12, 2027
Opening Reception: Friday, February 5, 2027 from 4-7pm
Location: Tyler Gallery, Radford University Art Museum
214 Tyler Avenue, Radford, VA 24141

Open to all mediums. 
Artists age 18+ in Western and West Central Virginia are encouraged to apply.

items.name: Silver Lake Exhibition 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Virginia Quilt Museum will be taking a Silver Lake exhibition on the road to two Mancuso shows in 2027. This exhibition will feature the historic quilt that started it all, Pat Sloan and Wendy Sheppard’s versions of the quilt, along with quilts selected from this call for entries. This exhibit will be on display at the Mid-Atlantic Quilt Festival from March 3 to 7, 2027, and the Pennsylvania National Quilt Extravaganza September 16 to 19, 2027. 

All entries must be based on the Silver Lake Pattern by Wendy Sheppard and they will be judged on use of color, craftsmanship, and overall aesthetic of the piece. Quilts must be finished quilts, but can be any size from a single block to a bed quilt. 

There will be an entry fee of $25 to submit a piece for consideration in the exhibition. Entries will be accepted from September 15 through December 1, 2026. Entrants will be notified of the results on December 15, 2026.

A total of 15 - 25 pieces will be chosen by the jurors.

items.name: Portrayed 5: A Juried National Exhibition of Portraits
items.shortDescription:
Portrayed is an all medium juried national exhibition of original and unique 2D and 3D portraiture artworks. Work must either depict a human figure, or a human face to be considered. 

This exhibition is open to all functional, non-functional, 2D, 3D, fine art, and fine art craft in ALL STYLES.

Works cannot exceed a weight of 50 pounds. Work can not be longer/larger than 60 inches in its longest dimension. Depending on artist involvement with installation, these stipulations may be waived. Wall hanging art must have a wire or cleat.

*** Size and weight restrictions may be waived by contacting the Gallery Director directly prior to submission. If you have a question about if your work qualifies, email abradley@d-artcenter.org. No phone calls please.

This is an in person exhibition but this exhibition will also be featured digitally on d’Art Center’s archive site.

items.name: INSIDE / OUTSIDE
items.shortDescription: Second Street Gallery invites you to apply to INSIDE / OUTSIDE, a juried exhibition for Virginia artists exploring the relationship between interior and exterior worlds through interpretations of landscape, home, history, memory, and place.

items.name: The Unseen -What Lies Beneath the Surface
items.shortDescription:
Enter The Unseen: What Lies Beneath the Surface, a Juried Exhibition, for a chance to exhibit your artwork at Artspace's gallery located at 2833-A Hathaway Rd., Richmond, VA 23225. This exhibition invites artists to explore hidden forces, dreams, memories, spirituality, mystery, imagination, and unseen systems that shape our experience of the world.

Artspace Gallery is a non-profit organization that prides itself on support and development of artists from all backgrounds. 

Notification of acceptance:  December 19.

Exhibition Dates: January 22 - March 20, 2025

Juror: Robert Stuart

items.name: The Deets: A National Exhibition of Intricate and Heavily Detailed Artworks
items.shortDescription:
The Deets exhibit will feature the art of meticulousness and showcase artworks that emphasize intricate detail, layered complexity, and exquisite finesse. From elaborate craftsmanship and subtle nuances to unexpected elements revealed upon closer inspection, these works invite viewers to slow down, look closer, and appreciate the artistry found in every mark, texture, and thoughtfully considered detail.

This exhibition will take place in our smaller exhibition space, The Vault, to create a more intimate and close up experience for our patrons. 

Hang/pedestal ready art (including the frame if applicable) can not be longer/larger than 36 inches in its longest dimension. Depending on artist involvement with installation, these stipulations may be waived by contacting the Gallery Director. 

If you have a question about if your work qualifies, please email abradley@d-artcenter.org. 

This is an in person exhibition & will also be featured digitally on d’Art Center’s archive site.

...

items.name: 2027 Olathe Outdoor Sculpture Series
items.shortDescription: Calling all sculptors! Submit your large-scale 3D artwork to the 2027 Olathe Outdoor Sculpture Series. Selected artists receive a $2,500 honorarium for a one-year lease, and the chance to be part of a celebrated tradition since 2004. Formerly centered downtown, this juried exhibit now spans the city, transforming public spaces and connecting our community through art. Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your work in a vibrant and growing city!

items.name: 2027 SCULPTURETOUR SALINA COMPETITION & EXHIBITION
items.shortDescription:
SculptureTour Salina (STS) is an annual curated exhibition in Salina, Kansas which includes juried work and direct selection of artists. Salina is an extraordinary community boasting a cultural vibe beyond expectations.
The STS exhibition is open to any artist creating work suitable for outdoor display. Between 20-25 sculptures are selected and carefully sited in historic downtown Salina. Sculptures
remain installed for one year and the program is marketed to provide both viewing enjoyment to community and visitors, and an opportunity to sell artists’ work.
To date, more than 40 sculptures have been purchased by local businesses and individuals.
Fifteen People’s Choice Award winning sculptures have also been purchased and placed in the community. The City of Salina designates up to $20,000 for the purchase of the People’s Choice ballot winner. The sculpture is then installed in a public environment within the community as part of Salina’s growing public art collection.

items.name: 2027 Supporting Neurodivergent Creatives
items.shortDescription: The Rotary Club of San Jose Neurodiversity Committee strives to support, recognize, and celebrate artists between the ages of 16 - 25 who identify as neurodivergent, including artists with autism, ADHD, dyslexia, dyscalculia, Down syndrome and artists with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

items.name: In The Abstract - IN PERSON EXHIBITION
items.shortDescription:
In the Abstract - IN PERSON EXHIBITION (artists MUST be able to deliver their work in person). SFVACC invites artists to enter our juried competition. Abstract art uses shapes, forms, color, line and texture as opposed to representing an accurate depiction of visual reality. Abstract art challenges artists to explore new ways of seeing and expressing themselves. 

Implicit to abstract art is the notion that the work of art exists in its own right, and not necessarily as a mirror of reality. -The Concise Oxford Dictionary of Art Terms

items.name: Art Makes a Great Gift - Special Event!
items.shortDescription:
For this 2-week special event, we invite artists to submit any artwork to be promoted for purchase prior to the holiday season. Otherwise, the theme is completely open.

Only $5 per artwork!

Artwork can be any medium (except AI), any style, any size, and created in any year.

KBM Art Gallery has nearly 10K followers on Instagram and nearly 20K on Twitter(X). Audiences worldwide see our shows!

This is an ONLINE ONLY exhibition. It runs Saturday, November 21st, 2026 through Friday December 4th, 2026.

Deadline to submit is Monday, November 16th.

items.name: Secrets
items.shortDescription:
CALL FOR ENTRIES & ELIGIBILITY
Falkirk Cultural Center invites artists residing within the nine counties of the San Francisco Bay Area to submit up to 3 separate pieces of original work completed in the past two years, not previously shown in a Falkirk Cultural Center exhibition.  Please provide 1 digital image per 2D work AND/ OR 3D work. 

Open to all media except jewelry, AI created images or videography. Only digitally uploaded images will be accepted. Digital entries, payment, and entry form must be received on or before midnight PST, Sunday, 12/6/26. 

ACCEPTED ENTRIES NOTIFICATION
Notifications made via email by Friday, 12/11/26. Separate email provided for each artwork. Separate email sent listing each submitted piece as invited or not.

ARTWORK DELIVERY DATES
Hand delivery only on Monday, 1/4/27 between 10am- 2pm at the Falkirk Cultural Center located at 1408 Mission Ave. San Rafael CA. Do not ship your piece(s).

items.name: The Sacred Ordinary
items.shortDescription:
The Sacred Ordinary invites artists to explore the beauty, meaning, and quiet significance found in everyday life. This theme considers how the mundane, domestic, familiar, or overlooked can be elevated into something sacred or extraordinary. Through personal experience, memory, ritual, observation, or transformation, artists are encouraged to reveal the wonder that may exist within ordinary moments, objects, places, and routines.

Artists are encouraged to interpret this theme broadly and in their own distinctive ways, using a variety of artistic mediums including painting, sculpture, collage, photography, and mixed media.

items.name: 2027 Los Angeles . Gallery Row Open Call
items.shortDescription:
NOW ACCEPTING SUBMISSIONS FOR 2027 PROGRAM

For the last seven years, Dama Gallery has called the Historic Core of Downtown Los Angeles home, growing inside Gallery Row and the city’s contemporary art community since 2019. In that time, we have built a devoted following among collectors, residents, artists, and visitors. 

Dama Gallery is a member of Gallery Association of Los Angeles (GA(LA), whose leadership and membership span some of the most respected names in the Los Angeles art world, from Gagosian and David Zwirner to Regen Projects and Christies.

Situated on Main Street Dama Gallery is listed on the First Thursdays DTLA ArtNight map among Hauser & Wirth, LACMA and The Broad. 

The Gallery Hangover, our IMDb-credited podcast is now entering it's fourth season, sharing our artists’ stories with a growing audience. As we enter our eighth year downtown, 2027 we are seeking bold, compelling voices to help shape a season of fresh perspectives and ambitious exhibitions.

items.name: Join Covet Marketplace (Nov 2026)
items.shortDescription:
🌟 Call for Artists – Showcase Your Work on Covet Art Gallery Marketplace! 🌟

Covet Art Gallery is looking for fresh, exciting talent to join our exclusive online marketplace,CovetArtGallery.com...a curated platform where artists upload and manage their own portfolios, connect with collectors, and grow their art business.

What are we looking for?
Like all of our calls, we’re drawn to the unique, the funky, the bold...to artists with a perspective that stands out. Any style, any medium, and a variety of price points are welcome.

📅 Submit now through Sunday Nov 29th.

Covet Gallery in Oceanside, CA (San Diego, California)
We can’t wait to see what you’ve got!

items.name: ART 4 Water
items.shortDescription:
"ART 4 Water" can include all sorts of interpretations of Water that PLANTS and ANIMALS need for Life!! All Mediums and ARTist are Welcome! Show us the ART Water inspires You to Create. We Welcome Creativity! Have FUN! We are ARTists who do Exhibits from an ARTist Perspective. We put our hARTs into making Exhibits for our fellow ARTists!

This Exhibit will promote water for the Accidental Animal Rescue Sanctuary for the benefactors and beneficials! Birds, Bees, Butterflies, Lizards, Cats, Dogs, Donkey and so many more lives that Water helps so much with. The Sanctuary is rural and as the weather is more challengingly HOT! our water tanks are rationed carefully. Every drop of liquid diamonds matters! We do drinking water all around, daily. There is no city tap to turn on in the foothills of the mountains where an ART Studio's growing gardens became a magnet for animals in need of sanctuary.  ART supports the Animals, and You too can make Positive Ripples of Water with Your ART 4 Wat...

items.name: 2027 Transparent Watercolor Society of America's 51st National Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
TRANSPARENT WATERCOLOR SOCIETY OF AMERICA

     $25,000+ in cash awards 

WWW.WATERCOLORS.ORG

IMPORTANT: When selecting your images from your portfolio, pls. review the contact information to verify it is correct/current.  Images previously uploaded may have outdated contact info.  If accepted and we cannot reach you, you will miss an opportunity to be in the exhibit.

ENTRY DEADLINE:  JANUARY 31, 2027

Exhibition Dates:  May 1, 2027 - August 1, 2027, Kenosha Public Museum, Kenosha, WI 

Entry Fee:  TWSA member in good standing and dues paid for 2027. Online Entry Only through CaFE  www.callforentry.org

items.name: E Pluribus: From Many
items.shortDescription:
Latino Arts, Inc., in partnership with Milwaukee School of Art & Design (MIAD), invites emerging and established artists age 18 and older from Wisconsin, Iowa, Minnesota, Illinois, and Michigan to submit up to two original works for a 2027 juried exhibition exploring the cultures, identities, communities, and experiences that enrich the American creative landscape.

Exhibition: March 5-June 4, 2027.

Entry fee: $40 per artwork.

 Deadline: January 10, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. CT.

items.name: 2027 Culture & Agriculture Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
39TH ANNUAL NATIONAL JURIED EXHIBITION • $2,850 IN AWARDS
Gallery Q presents the 39th Annual Culture & Agriculture Exhibition in Stevens Point, Wisconsin, celebrating agriculture, rural life, and the land through the eyes of artists from across the country. Open to artists age 18+ in the United States working in two- and three-dimensional media, digital art, and video art.

items.name: SawMural! Mini-Mural Festival
items.shortDescription:
The Public Art Urban Enhancement Division invites greater Albuquerque area (Bernalillo, Sandoval, Torrance, and Valencia counties) artists to apply for consideration to create a mural for the inaugural year of the SawMural! Mini-Mural Festival. This will be a project managed by the City of Albuquerque Public Art Urban Enhancement Division.  

SawMural! Mini-Mural Festival is a public art and creative workforce development initiative that will transform a 1,000-foot segment of the Rail Trail into a vibrant open-air gallery.

items.name: Not Too Much off the Top: Barbershops and Salons as Gathering Spaces
items.shortDescription:
The Black Barbershop and Salon have long been a haven for the Black community. Not only is it a space for personal care and maintenance, but also a place for community organizing, and jovial yet critical conversations.

Not Too Much Off The Top seeks to highlight this important third space, welcomes all conversations surrounding the barbershop and salon and encourages a more introspective investigation of this institution. This national exhibition is looking for Black artists of all identities in the diaspora to share their experience in this space.

Artists are encouraged to submit 2D and 3D works that reflect on themes outlined in this call for art. The exhibition will run at the Arts Center Gallery in Fayetteville, NC, from January 22 to February 28, 2027. Online submissions are accepted until December 15, 2026.

items.name: WCU Fine Art Museum - 59th Annual Juried Undergraduate Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
Western Carolina University’s Annual Juried Undergraduate Exhibition is one of the longest-running Catamount art traditions. This exhibition is an extraordinary opportunity for WCU undergraduate students to share their artwork with a larger public and to enhance their skills in presenting artwork in a professional gallery setting. Entries are reviewed by an outside art professional who selects the works for exhibition at the WCU Fine Art Museum. Selected works will be on view at the Museum from Feb 16 through Mar 25, 2027. This year, the exhibition juror is Andy Cline, a painter, process artist, and scenic artist working between Japan and North Carolina.

There are three steps to the application process: 

  1. Create a CaFE account at callforentry.org.
  2. Upload your images/video/audio files to your CaFE account.
  3. Apply to the 59th Annual Juried Undergraduate Exhibition call at callforentry.org. Applicants must submit a one-paragraph artist statement (50-150 words) that describes their artwork.

items.name: 16th Annual International Juried Exhibition - Solastalgia
items.shortDescription:
The A.D. Gallery at the University of North Carolina at Pembroke welcomes all interpretations of the theme, Solastalgia: the emotional distress of watching your home environment change around you.

Artists are invited to submit two-dimensional or three-dimensional works, installations, or digital media (including video-based media). AI-generated work will not be considered.

items.name: Outdoor DownEast Sculpture Exhibition 2027-28
items.shortDescription:
This is the year long outdoor component of the DownEast National Juried Sculpture Exhibition is located in Pitt County, North Carolina. This year, we celebrate 21 years of DownEast Sculptures! 

The exhibition has two components: a month-long indoor exhibition and a year-long outdoor exhibition. 

The DownEast outdoor sculpture exhibition is a joint exhibition in Pitt County with partnerships including Pitt County Arts Council at Emerge, ECU Student Galleries, City of Greenville, Pitt County Cultural Arts and Recreation, Town of Winterville, Town of Farmville, Town of Ayden, Wahl-Coates Elementary School for the Arts, Pitt-Greenville Airport, and the Greenville Museum of Art.

items.name: 18th Annual International Drawing Discourse Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
EXHIBITION: As part of an ongoing commitment to promote drawing practices in the visual arts, the University of North Carolina Asheville invites artists to submit entries to a Juried International Exhibition of contemporary drawing. UNC Asheville seeks to examine drawing as it is practiced and defined by today’s artists. Such an exhibition will demonstrate the continued significance of drawing through both conventional and innovative methods. 

JUROR’S LECTURE: Michael Grimaldi will open with a lecture on January 15, 2027, from 5:00-6:00 p.m. An opening reception will immediately follow. 

CATALOGUE: A full-color catalogue will be printed. Each exhibited artist will receive one complimentary copy; additional copies will be available for purchase. 

AWARDS: $2000 in cash prizes, as chosen by the Juror, will be awarded. A pur...

items.name: DownEast Indoor Sculpture Exhibition 2027
items.shortDescription:
What is DownEast?

The DownEast National Juried Sculpture Exhibition began as a local showcase of student sculptural work in 2006. It has grown into two components: a month-long indoor exhibition and a year-long outdoor exhibition.

items.name: OPEN CALL: ONGOING
items.shortDescription:
Submit anytime / Artists selected monthly

Current Artist

 Rolling Open Call for Visual Artists
(International | All Mediums | Online Exhibition)

FEATURED ARTIST OF THE MONTH — Juried Monthly Award
Rolling open call for visual artists.  
One artist is selected each month through a juried review and recognized as the featured Artist of the Month.
Open worldwide • All visual art mediums • No theme • No deadline.

Submit your strongest work at any time. This is an ongoing, rolling open call for visual artists.

Submissions are reviewed on a rolling basis through a monthly juried review. Each month, one artist is juried and selected as the Featured Artist of the Month, receiving elevated visibility and promotion.

There is no theme and no fixed deadline. Artists may submit when their work is ready and may submit multiple times throughout the year.

items.name: BAC Artists
items.shortDescription:
Boyne Arts Center ｜Artist Info 

Thank you for your interest in becoming an artist with Boyne Arts Center. We aim to support local artists, present high-quality work, and offer meaningful exhibition opportunities in our gallery and partner locations.

items.name: Au Naturel: the Nude in the 21st Century 2027
items.shortDescription: Clatsop Community College announces our seventeenth annual international juried exhibition, Au Naturel: the Nude in the 21st Century, to be held January 21 - March 11, 2027 in the Royal Nebeker Art Gallery, with a reception onThursday, February 12 at 6 p.m..  Au Naturel is an international juried competition open to all artists working in any drawing, painting, and printmaking media with a focus on the nude human figure as subject matter in any form ranging from representational to abstract, and in which the handmade mark is employed as the primary means of image-making. Please note: a limited number of three-dimensional works may also be considered. (Note:  image above - Elena Frost, The Abduction of a Sabine Woman)

items.name: Unreal - 2026 (4th Annual Juried Exhibition, Publication, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Unreal 2026: When Imagination Breaks Free

Showcase your surreal art to revolutionize visitors' imagination

Gallerium proudly presents Unreal 2026, the 4th annual juried exhibition, publication, and sales art opportunity to present a world beyond ordinary.

As a free form of artistic expression, surreal works are a gateway to the unknown, where the ordinary rules and familiar world fade in order to pave the way for a world of dreams, fantasy, and irrational imaginations.

Express your artistic talent, and share your surreal world to unlock people’s minds and show them a unique experience of the unseen and unknown through the fantastic world of art.

The subject is free as surreal work includes a vast range of art from abstract to hyper-realism inspired by the world beyond the ordinary.

Artists working in any 2D and 3D medium from anywhere in the world are invited to join this unique art opportunity.

Visit last year's exhibition at: https://www.gallerium.art/unreal-2025

items.name: One of a Kind Holiday Show Chicago 2026
Biafarin 6th Annual Awards - 2026 (Grant, Publication, Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Submit to Biafarin Awards to gain global exposure and win 10,000 in cash and prizes

Biafarin proudly presents Biafarin Awards 2026; the 6th annual juried international art awards with cash grants and prizes, open to visual artists working in any medium worldwide.

Now, in its fifth year, and with more than $10,000 in cash grants and valuable prizes, Biafarin awards provides an exceptional opportunity to artists, emerging or experienced, to get noticed by art experts, collectors, and art enthusiasts worldwide.

The award intends to reward artists' efforts to elevate awareness and justice and keep hope, peace, and happiness alive via their art in this challenging time.

Submission and selection is free. No fees to submit and no fees, if selected by jury.

Visit last year's exhibition at: https://www.biafarin.com/ba2025

items.name: HMVC Gallery presents [2026]
items.shortDescription:
Our annual exhibition, "2026," invites artists to showcase works created this year, celebrating their creative journeys. It encourages submissions inspired by memories, milestones, and artistic curiosity, allowing participants to share their personal transformations and cultural responses. This is an opportunity to contribute to a vibrant finale of the year through impactful artwork.

We welcome artworks from all mediums of visual art, except AI-created art.

AWARDS:

All Artists participating in the online group show will be featured on our Website and Virtual Gallery. All artists will be awarded an HMVC Gallery New York certificate of participation. A video clip of “2026” featuring all participating artists’ artworks will be screened on a jumbotron billboard in New York City’s famous Times Square later in December.

Best of show winner: $150
Second place winner: $100
Third place winner: Online Solo Show
All Artworks: Times Square Jumbotron Billboard (when possible)

items.name: BOAPS - Winter 2027 (Grants, Publication, Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
BOAPS – Winter 2027 is our 4th seasonal international open art opportunity presented by Biafarin, offering visual artists worldwide the chance to gain global exposure and receive cash grants. Established following spring seasonal and 5 consecutive years of the Biafarin Awards, BOAPS expands Biafarin’s commitment to supporting artists through exhibitions, publications, promotion, and sales opportunities.

Open to emerging and established artists working in all visual media, BOAPS – Winter 2027 welcomes artworks on any subject. Artists are invited to submit abstract or representational works in any 2D or 3D medium. 

Selected artists will benefit from distributed cash grants, curated international smart online group and solo exhibitions, global online and social media promotion, publication in official catalogues and art magazines, sales opportunities, and long-term visibility through lifetime artist profile pages on the Biafarin platform.

items.name: What Would You Do With $1000
items.shortDescription:
The No More Starving Artists Foundation (NMSAF) is pleased to announce the launch of their 2026 Microgrant, What Would You Do With $1000. This microgrant’s goal is to support the creation of new work, the completion of an ongoing project, professional development, or a new experimental concept to help enhance the artist’s work.

NMSAF is a 501(c)3 that’s goal is to help artists of all disciplines build a strong legacy through their artistic profession. Their mission is to help primarily Palm Beach County artists be sustainable personally and professionally by providing opportunities and service

items.name: Duluth Handmade Holiday Market 2026, (DULUTH, GA)
items.shortDescription:
The Handmade Holiday Market is part of the annual “Deck the Hall” celebration presented by the City of Duluth in the heart of historic Downtown Duluth, Georgia. Set on the Town Green and surrounding Main Street district, this festive market is integrated into one of Gwinnett County’s most beloved holiday traditions, drawing families from across metro Atlanta for a full day and evening of seasonal activities.

Visitors come to enjoy the city’s tree lighting, Santa visits, live entertainment, food vendors, and holiday attractions — all while strolling through a curated marketplace of handmade goods. The event is designed as a walk-through holiday village, allowing patrons to circulate throughout the district multiple times, creating strong engagement and excellent buying energy for artists and makers.

This family-oriented audience arrives specifically in a gift-buying mindset, making the market especially successful for handcrafted items, seasonal décor, ornaments, candles, jewelry, woodwork, and personalized gifts. Evening hours are particularly active as the Town Green lights up and crowds gather for the holiday celebration.

Downtown Duluth’s restaurants, shops, and free public parking contribute to a welcoming, pedestrian-friendly environment where visitors linger and shop. The City heavily promotes the event through municipal channels and community outreach, helping generate consistent attendance and repeat visitors each year.

Festival Hours: Saturday 2pm - 6pm

items.name: Fort Myers Beach Holly Jolly Art & Craft Show Holiday Market 8th annual
items.shortDescription:
8th annual Holly Jolly Market is a marvelous opportunity to purchase last minute handmade items and holiday gifts in a beautiful setting the week before Christmas. Event has moved back to the island.   Situated in downtown Fort Myers Beach at Times Square.  This location is amongst restaurants, shops and down by Margaritaville.    
  • Open Saturday & Sunday 10am to 5pm

items.shortDescription:
This 8th annual 2 day art and craft show takes place in the heart of Holmes beach on Anna Maria Island at City Field on Marina Drive, across from The Ugly Grouper.

items.name: Palm Harbor Florida Craft Festival: 6th Annual November 2026 American Craft Endeavors
items.shortDescription: We are excited to return to Palm Harbor! Located on Florida's west coast, right next to the Gulf of Mexico, Palm Harbor is known for its vibrant community and welcoming small-town atmosphere. Often referred to as the Jewel of Tampa Bay, this city lies just north of Dunedin and showcases a charming architectural heritage that reflects Florida’s history. Numerous restaurants and retail shops are housed in historic buildings and residences. Palm Harbor is part of the Tampa Bay Metropolitan Area and is conveniently close to Clearwater, Tampa, and St. Petersburg.

items.name: Completed 2D Artwork from Mercer County Artists: Maternal and Infant Health Innovation Center
items.shortDescription:
The Maternal and Infant Health Innovation Center in Trenton is a newly constructed office building in the State Capital Complex neighborhood. The State is seeking to purchase completed two-dimensional artwork for display in the new building. This call is open only to New Jersey artists who are permanent residents of Mercer County, or maintain a permanent art studio address in Mercer County. Employees of the State of New Jersey are not eligible to submit for this call.

The project seeks to acquire multiple, completed, ready to install two-dimensional artworks priced at or under $1000.

Entry Deadline: January 7, 2027 at 11:59 PM EMT

Zoom Q&A | December 11, 2026 at Noon: https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_LZPJU0d9S56l1gIGqTRNyA#/registration

The New Jersey State Council on the Arts is managing this Public Art Inclusion process, serving its mission to facilitate the inclusion of art in every public building in New Jersey.

items.name: Artist Accelerator Program Spring 2027
items.shortDescription:
Generously sponsored by Creative Sonoma and the County of Sonoma 

SebArts Artist Accelerator Program is designed to empower and support artists on their journey to establish themselves as successful and sustainable artists by providing professional development. This comprehensive program encompasses various aspects of their careers, from artistic development to financial management and community building.

 New this year - program includes $500 stipend to accepted artists.

The program encourages artists at any stage of their career to apply. Only artists that live in Sonoma County will be considered.

items.name: Prime Desert Woodland Preserve Artist in Residence Program
items.shortDescription:
The Prime Desert Woodland Preserve Artist in Residence Program invites artists of all disciplines to explore the landscape, ecology, and history of the Prime Desert Woodland Preserve in Lancaster, California.

The program is open to artists age 18 and older living in Southern California. It provides a $1,500 stipend, up to six hotel stays, studio access at the Cedar Creative Incubator, and curatorial support.

items.name: SCG Artist in Residence & Teaching Program (SCG ART) 2027 - National
items.shortDescription:
The SCG ART program brings established artists to Placer County for the purpose of teaching and sharing their artistic talents and experience to the greater community. The program was lovingly established at PCF in memory of a local artist, Susan Cooley Gilliom, by her family.

This residency offers a large studio space, funding for projects, and the opportunity to teach workshops in a formal setting, along with the ability to exhibit work in the studio space and offer pieces for sale throughout the duration of the residency. 

To learn more about this program and see a list of past artists, visit: http://placercf.org/visiting-artist/

items.name: Joshua Tree Highlands Artist Residency 2027-2028
items.shortDescription:
Joshua Tree Highlands Artist Residency 2027-2028

Submission Deadline: December 15, 2026

Seven Week Artist Residencies:

MAY 4, 2027  -  JUNE 22, 2027
AUGUST  24, 2027  - OCTOBER 12, 2027
JANUARY 11, 2028  - FEBRUARY 29, 2028

VISUAL ARTISTS MUST SUBMIT A MINIMUM OF FIVE IMAGES.  WRITERS SHOULD SUBMIT A MAXIMUM OF 20 PAGES.  ALL ARTISTS ARE EXPECTED TO SUBMIT A PROJECT PROPOSAL.  

Artists selected will be announced on FEBRUARY 28, 2027

items.name: 2027 Pennsylvania Watercolor Society Online Members Show
items.shortDescription: PWS Members online Show 2026

items.name: 54th Annual Hoyt Regional Juried Art Show
items.shortDescription: The Hoyt Arts Center invites artists ages 18 and older living within 250 miles of New Castle, PA, to enter its 54th Annual Hoyt Regional Juried Art Competition. Open to a variety of artistic media, this annual exhibition celebrates the talent and creativity of regional artists, offering an opportunity to showcase their work, gain recognition, and compete for $1,200+ in cash prizes. This year's juror is Anatasia James, the newly appointed director of the Butler Institute of American Art.

items.name: Art For Everyone 2027
items.shortDescription:
Presented by Rena Charles Gallery in Healdsburg, CA, Art for Everyone is a community exhibition celebrating creativity in all its forms. This special annual showing invites artists of every background and experience level to share
their work in a professional fine art gallery setting.

items.name: PhotoSpiva 2027
items.shortDescription:
PhotoSpiva 2027 – Celebrating 51 Years!
National Photographic Competition & Exhibition

Will exhibit from March 20 – May 29, 2027
Online entry is from November 6, 2026 – January 4, 2027, at 11:59 pm.  

Hosted annually by Spiva Center for the Arts, the competition is open to all amateur and professional US photographers.

Established in 1977, PhotoSpiva is the longest-running competition of its kind.

PhotoSpiva will is presented in the Main Gallery at the state-of-the-art Harry M. Cornell Arts and Entertainment Complex and is accompanied by some of Spiva's signature programming: PhotoSpiva Kids, Spiva in Bloom, and the 1000 Words Poetry Event.

PLEASE NOTE: No work that is accepted may be framed. Instructions for the matting of the images will be sent if work is accepted.

items.name: PURELY IMAGINARY
items.shortDescription:
PURELY IMAGINARY — An International Juried Exhibition

Reality has rules. Your imagination has other plans.

Palm Art Gallery invites artists into **Purely Imagination**, an exhibition where dreams interrupt everyday life, the subconscious takes the wheel, and the impossible makes itself at home. Bring us your phantasms, invented worlds, beautiful obsessions, and familiar things turned wonderfully strange. Whether your vision is playful, mysterious, intimate, or extravagant, let us see what happens when your inner world takes over.

Give us something reality could never have dreamed up.

items.name: Artistonish Magazine - 77th Issue - December 2026
items.shortDescription:
Get published and astonish art lovers with your brilliant art

Artistonish invites you to submit your original art for publishing in the magazine's 77th issue in December 2026.

Artistonish is an international contemporary art magazine published by Discover the Artist Media since 2020. 

Each magazine issue presents significant artworks created by brilliant artists from all around the world. 

Both online and print-on-demand versions of the magazine are published in full-color glossy A4 pages and will be accessible to thousands of art experts, collectors, and enthusiasts from over 150 countries. Each artwork image will be showcased separately in one full page, including artwork data, artist photo, and a lifetime active link associated with a QR code.

Moreover, all selected artists will receive social media promotional badges, digital certificates, readers' ratings and comments, and analytic reports.

Submission is free, and a fixed small fee applies to selected artists only.

items.name: Pet Art - 2027 (2nd Juried Annual Exhibition, Publication, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Pet Art 2027: Celebrating Companionship and Love

Some bonds leave marks that never fade. Who has left theirs on you?

Gallerium proudly presents Pet Art 2027, the 2nd annual juried international art opportunity that celebrates the art of companionship, loyalty, and love through the lives of our pets.

This heartfelt opportunity invites artists worldwide to explore themes including the human–animal bond, memory and loss, healing and therapy, pets in culture and history, whimsical humor, animal personalities, and the diversity of pets across species. From realistic portraits and daily life scenes to symbolic, abstract, or fantastical interpretations, we welcome all media and styles.

Submitting to Pet Art 2027 is more than gaining visibility or sales—it is an opportunity to honor the creatures who walk beside us, touch our lives, and mirror our humanity.

Because sometimes the smallest paws leave the largest marks.

Last year's exhibition: https://www.gallerium.art/petart-2026

items.name: Western Loudoun Art and Studio Tour (WLAST)
items.shortDescription: Loudoun County, Virginia artists over the age of 18 working in all visual media may apply to this juried event. Those selected will open their studios to the public for 2 or 3 days, presenting their work to visitors from the metropolitan region. Professional and emerging visual artists whose studios in Western Loudoun County meet specific criteria may apply as Studio Artists. Loudoun County artists who do not have a Western Loudoun studio suitable for visitors may apply as Guest Artists. Two- and three-dimensional work will be considered, including but not limited to painting, drawing, fiber art, wood, ceramics, glass, photography, sculpture and jewelry. All applications must be submitted through CaFE in order to be considered.

items.name: Paint Grand Traverse 2027
items.shortDescription:
The ​Crooked Tree Arts Center in Traverse City, Michigan, seeks artists for the national plein air painting festival, Paint Grand Traverse, now in its ninth year. Paint Grand Traverse is a plein air (outdoor) painting festival and competition featuring 33 artists from across the country.

Prizes and Awards: 
Best of Show: ​$3,500 cash award. A total of $18,000 in cash and prizes will be awarded in a variety of categories.

items.name: AZPA Online Juried Theme Gallery Call: The Natural World
items.shortDescription:
Arizona Photography Alliance (AZPA) is celebrating its third year of Juried Theme Gallery Call Online Exhibitions. This is an open call to all current AZPA members* and non-members. Non-members are welcome to join to become eligible for the reduced rate.

The third Theme Gallery call in 2026 is, The Natural World: Earth, Wind, Fire, and Water are primordial forces that shape the natural world we inhabit. Each contains within it both beauty and the potential for immense havoc.

Submit your best photographic work that supports this broad topic!

If you would like to join us, view memberships here.

items.name: Faces & Figures
items.shortDescription: People watching, enjoying a sporting event, or watching children at play. Is it a facial expression that catches your interest or the way an individual moves? We invite you to share faces and figures using fiber and/or fiber and textile techniques. The exhibition will be juried by the Fiber Art Now creative team and will be featured in the spring 2027 issue of Fiber Art Now, to be released in early April 2027. Selected artwork will be eligible for the on-site exhibition at Springfield Museum of Art in Springfield, Ohio, in the early fall of 2028. springfieldart.net

items.name: 2027 Orange County Artist Guild New Membership
items.shortDescription:
The Orange County Artists Guild is an inclusive, non-profit organization of artists supporting each other in their professional development, as well as fostering public knowledge and appreciation of the work of local artists. The Guild is composed of professional artists and artisans. The Guild does not restrict members as to art medium, content, or style of work. All members are expected to contribute to the organization through voluntary committee work. Activities of the Guild include:

  • Hosting an annual Orange County Open Studio Tour in November
  • Hosting annual Winter and Spring shows when possible
  • Hosting an informational booth at Festifall
  • Providing a website to promote OCAG members’ artwork
  • Offering organizational Facebook and Instagram pages
  • Hosting quarterly meetings for members with educational programs and speakers
  • Seeking out and coordinating other opportunities to show and sell members work
  • Promoting and organizing self-led artist interest and learning groups

items.name: BLACK IS BLACK
items.shortDescription:
BLACK IS BLACK — Where Color Comes Alive

Black makes color impossible to ignore. Reds ignite. Blues deepen. A quiet detail suddenly steals the scene.

Palm Art Gallery invites you to submit work that reveals black’s power to make color sing. A bold outline, a sweeping background, a dramatic shadow, or one perfectly placed accent—black can transform the entire image.

From vibrant abstraction to intimate portraits, landscapes, and unexpected experiments, all styles and media are welcome. Look again at your favorite pieces: where does black make the difference?

Show us the work that makes viewers stop and look.

items.name: Expressions West 2027
items.shortDescription:
Expressions West is a juried exhibition featuring contemporary artwork by artists from across the American West. The exhibition is open to artists living in Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Hawaii, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming. Presented by Coos Art Museum, Expressions West celebrates the range of ideas, perspectives, and creative work being produced across the region. 

First Place: $1000 

Second Place: $750.00 

Third Place: $250.00

items.name: Aesthetics - 2027 (4th Juried Annual Exhibition, Publication, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Exhibit and publish beauty, awe, and illusion through the aesthetic aspects of your art

Gallerium proudly presents Aesthetics 2027, the 4th juried annual exhibition, publication, and sales opportunity to share various aspects of aesthetics in art.

Aesthetics is defined as the pleasing qualities in an art piece. In visual art, factors such as balance, scale, shape, color, movement, and visual weight can determine aesthetic attributes. 

For Aesthetics 2027, the subject is free, and we are looking for artworks that connect with the viewers and create an emotional engagement. We would like to see a range of classical, modern, and creatively odd artistic interpretations of Aesthetics.

Aesthetics celebrates contemporary visual arts in all forms and mediums, welcoming all abstract and representational artists to submit their art.

Submission is free, and a small fixed fee applies to selected artists only.

Visit last year's exhibition at: https://www.gallerium.art/aesthetics-2025

items.name: By Hand: An Exhibition of Contemporary Alternative Process Photography
items.shortDescription:
Texas Photographic Society is proud to announce the call for entry for By Hand: An Exhibition of Contemporary Alternative Process Photography, our sixth exhibition featuring hand-made photo-based imagery created using alternative photographic processes and historical printing methods. Our juror is acclaimed fine art photographer, author, and educator Jill Enfield. (See full bio and juror's statement below.) This call is open to artists of all levels internationally.

By Hand will open at the Wilma and Terence Dennis Gallery at Austin College in Sherman, Texas, on February 8, 2027 and run through March 26, 2027.

items.name: West Michigan Art Competition 2027
items.shortDescription: The 41st Annual Lowell Arts West Michigan Art Competition highlights outstanding artwork by Michigan artists. Artwork will be accepted from a 42-county region of lower West Michigan. Artwork in any visual art media can be submitted by artists 18 yrs. and older. Cash awards totaling $4000 are presented. Artists may submit one piece for consideration by the juror.

items.name: MORE ARTFUL COOKING
items.shortDescription:
100 Artists • 100 Recipes • 100 Stories

Following the tremendous success of our first Artful Cooking cookbook, Artists of Palm Beach County is excited to announce plans for a new, expanded hardcover edition featuring 100 APBC artists.

items.name: Open Theme: 2026
items.shortDescription: Black Box Gallery is excited to announce an open themed juried group photo show. Show us your favorite photographic shots! Open to all themes and ideas, all styles and genres, all perspectives on crafsmanship and photographic creativity. Great opportunity for landscape, architecture, portraiture, documentary, fashion, still life, conceptual projects, street, color and black and white, nature, night photography. This will be an exciting exhibition with a great diversity of photographs!

items.name: 2027 CPAC Open International Call for Photography | MOP Denver
items.shortDescription: The Colorado Photographic Arts Center (CPAC) seeks work for an open call for the 2027 Month of Photography Denver Festival (MOP). CPAC will be digitally projecting selected work on to the Daniels & Fisher Tower on 16th Street Mall in downtown Denver as part of Night Lights Denver during the entire month of March 2027. Including horizontal images to be projected on the Denver Theatre District's new LED screen in Skyline Park.

items.name: The LeRoy Neiman and Janet Byrne Neiman Foundation Student Design Competition Presented by Riddell
items.shortDescription: The LeRoy Neiman and Janet Byrne Neiman Foundation Student Design Competition: Presented by Riddell at the KSU Downtown Gallery, January 29 - March 6, 2027. University wide football helmet design competition.

items.name: BLUE Photography Exhibition
items.shortDescription: Decode Gallery is happy to announce our upcoming theme, Blue. You can find blue everywhere, from landscapes and seascapes to portraits and abstracts.

items.name: 46th Annual Juried Friends Show
items.shortDescription:
Now in its 46th year, the Sedona Arts Center (SAC) is excited to present its annual Juried Friends Show and Sale. Artists of all levels, working in all mediums are invited to enter but you must be a donor at the Sedona Arts Center (SAC) Friend Level, which starts at $70. If interested in becoming a new donor at the Friend Level, visit our website: www.sedonaartscenter.org

Deadline for entries: February 5, 2027

The exhibition will run from March 5 – April 18, 2027

items.name: Darkness Photography Exhibition
items.shortDescription: Send us your images that know the weight of an unlit room, your portraits of the unseen, your landscapes of the hour before dawn, your still lifes of the barely visible, your reckonings with the void through the lens.

items.name: 2027 Mid-Atlantic Juried Show
items.shortDescription:
You are invited to apply to be a part of McGuffey Art Center’s Third Annual Mid-Atlantic Juried Show! 

McGuffey Art Center is located in downtown Charlottesville, VA and is one of the oldest artist-run cooperative art centers in the country. The show will take place April 2 - May 1, 2027 in the historic elementary school building that is McGuffey’s home and will feature an opening reception on Friday, April 2, 2026, 5:30 - 7:30pm

Any artist at least 18 years of age, residing in Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Washington DC, or North Carolina may enter. All work must be original and completed within the last three years.The competition is open to the following categories: painting, drawing, photography, printmaking, fiber, sculpture and mixed media. 2-D entries should not exceed 8 feet in any direction. No entry that requires the artist to be present for moving or assembly will be accepted.

items.name: Wings - 2027 (4th Annual Juried Exhibition, Publication, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Bring your winged visions to life—real or surreal, natural or fantastical.

Gallerium proudly presents Wings 2027, its 4th annual juried art opportunity, inviting visual artists worldwide to spread their creative wings and soar beyond the familiar

Now in its fourth year, Wings has become more than a theme—it’s a symbol of imagination, ascension, transformation, and the human desire to transcend. This unique juried art opportunity blends a smart international online exhibition and Artsy feature with a professional art publication, providing selected artists with a powerful platform for exposure, celebration, and sales.

Whether grounded in reality or lifted by fantasy, Wings have long captured our collective dreams. They speak of freedom, power, divinity, escape, and rebirth. Through Wings 2027, we invite you to bring those meanings to life through your own creative expressions.

Explore the previous Wings exhibition: https://www.gallerium.art/wings-2025

items.name: Gallery of Hermosa: Best of the Beach
items.shortDescription:
Local, national, and international artists are invited to participate in the "Best of The Beach" Exhibit, presented by the Gallery of Hermosa and Easy Reader News at the Gallery of Hermosa space in Hermosa Beach, CA!

We're seeking high-quality artwork that interprets "Best of the Beach" through your unique artistic lens and experiences. What does "Best of the Beach" look like to you? This is not necessarily a Beach-themed show.

  • Submission deadline: Sunday, November 22, 2026
  • Decisions emailed: Monday, November 30, 2026
  • Opening reception & awards: Saturday, December 12, 2026, 2–5 PM
  • Exhibition: December 12, 2026 – January 10, 2027

Awards

  • Best in Show: $500 prize + article in Easy Reader News
  • Second Place: $200 prize
  • Third Place: $100 prize
  • Four Additional Awards: $50 each
  • Awards will be announced at the opening reception, and winners need not be present to win.

items.name: Artistonish Magazine - 76th Issue - November 2026
items.shortDescription:
Get published and astonish art lovers with your brilliant art

Artistonish invites you to submit your original art for publishing in the magazine's 76th issue in November 2026.

Artistonish is an international contemporary art magazine published by Discover the Artist Media since 2020. 

Each magazine issue presents significant artworks created by brilliant artists from all around the world. 

Both online and print-on-demand versions of the magazine are published in full-color glossy A4 pages and will be accessible to thousands of art experts, collectors, and enthusiasts from over 150 countries. Each artwork image will be showcased separately in one full page, including artwork data, artist photo, and a lifetime active link associated with a QR code.

Moreover, all selected artists will receive social media promotional badges, digital certificates, readers' ratings and comments, and analytic reports.

Submission is free, and a fixed small fee applies to selected artists only.

items.name: Illuminated
items.shortDescription: Gallery 114 is proud to announce our upcoming community juried exhibition titled Illuminated, which will bring a range of artists together to celebrate the magic of light in the late days of Winter. This exhibition is being produced in conjunction with Portland’s popular annual Winter Light Festival which runs Feb. 5-13, 2027 and will be an official program of that event receiving promotion and other benefits from that organization.

items.name: THE ROOM NEXT DOOR
items.shortDescription:
THE ROOM NEXT DOOR 
is an international juried photography call from Decagon Gallery.

Juror: Susan Bright

We seek photographs that live in nearness: a lit window across the courtyard, a bedroom no one sleeps in anymore, a voice through the wall. Images that suggest more than they show: mysterious, never obscure, and always offering the viewer a way in. Documentary, staged, conceptual, color or black and white, all welcome.

Selected work will be exhibited online at Decagon Gallery, January 10 – March 10, 2027.

Deadline: December 15, 2026.

Notification: January 1, 2027.

$1,000 Cash Prizes.

items.name: RC50: A City in Focus
items.shortDescription:
The City of Rancho Cucamonga is seeking original photography by local community members. RC50: A City in Focus is a citywide photography exhibition celebrating the City’s 50th Anniversary by showcasing the people, places, and stories that define our community. Through a public call for photography submissions, residents, local photographers, and community members will have the opportunity to share their unique perspectives of Rancho Cucamonga.  

The original photograph submissions can be in one of the following file types PDF, .ai, .psd, TIFF or JPEG. TIFF and JPEG need to be a minimum of 150 DPI and a minimum of 2,000 pixels. The final digital photograph will then be integrated into an exhibit layout by a third-party vendor. 

Selected artists will be paid a $200 stipend. Applicants may submit one (1) entry. Open to all ages (with parent/guardian permission for minors).

items.name: Masur Museum of Art's 64th Annual Juried Competition
items.shortDescription:
Since 1963, the Masur Museum of Art’s Annual Juried Competition has been a platform for emerging contemporary artists working across the United States. Open to all media and styles, this exhibition has become the museum’s longest-running tradition and one of its most anticipated shows each year.

Each cycle, 1,000–1,500 works are submitted nationwide, while only a select group will be chosen to be on view for four months at the Masur. Alongside institutional recognition, chosen artists will compete for $3,200 in cash prizes awarded to first, second, and third place winners.

This is your opportunity to showcase your work to a diverse public audience, build your exhibition record, and be part of a tradition that has shaped the museum’s history for over sixty years.

Submit today and secure your chance to be part of this historical exhibition.

items.name: CAL International 2027
items.shortDescription: Artists, aged 18 or over, both national and international, are invited to enter original 2D and 3D artwork in this juried competition and $5,500 will be awarded to the winners. The juror is Taft McWhorter (https://www.taftmcwhorterart.com/). Mr. McWhorter will select from entered artworks those eligible to exhibit in The Madeley Fine Art Gallery in March 2027 and to be eligible for awards.

items.name: ArtsQuest Fine Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 38th Annual ArtsQuest Fine Arts Festival is set for May 1 & 2 in the beautiful Town Center of Grand Boulevard at Sandestin, nestled in the vibrant and scenic vacation destination of south Walton County along Florida's Gulf Coast.

Hosted by the Cultural Arts Alliance of Walton County, ArtsQuest invites art lovers, families, and collectors to discover and purchase original works from more than 150 talented artists traveling from across the country. Guests can enjoy a weekend filled with live music, artist demonstrations, interactive art activities, student exhibits, and delicious food and drinks — all in the lively atmosphere of Grand Boulevard.

As one of the Cultural Arts Alliance’s signature events, ArtsQuest plays a vital role in our mission to nurture creativity and connect our community through the inclusive and collaborative celebration of the arts. We can’t wait to welcome you to this unforgettable weekend of art, music, and inspiration!

items.name: Santa Fe College Spring Arts Festival 2027 - 55th Annual
items.shortDescription:
Santa Fe College announces the 55th Spring Arts Festival. The festival will continue to take place on our picturesque Northwest Campus in Gainesville, Florida. To provide better access and visibility to the public, Santa Fe (SF) is moving the site location to a prominent area on the northeast corner of our campus centered around our beautiful Jackson N. Sasser Fine Arts Hall. This new location will allow drive-up access for set up and break down on pavement with level ground for artists and visitors. We would like to invite you to be a part of North Central Florida’s finest annual springtime arts celebration. Santa Fe College is dedicated to providing the ultimate experience for our artists and guests.

Event Date & Hours: Saturday, April 10th, 10:00 am to 5:00 pm and Sunday, April 11th, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm. Drive in set up will be on Friday, April 9th 1:00 - 8:00 pm.
10’ X 10’ booth space sizes. Double booths are available.

$22,000 in Awards (Please see detailed explanation in General Information of the Best of Show and other awards.)

Santa Fe College will market the event through a statewide publicity program.

Over 15,000 visitors are anticipated to attend.

items.name: Colorium - 2026 (4th Juried Annual Exhibition, Publication, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Colorium 2026: A Celebration of Color, Creation, and Connection

Gallerium proudly presents Colorium - 2026. 

Colors (or their absence) have been an essential element for creating visual arts. Any colorful, unicolor, black-and-white or neutral-color piece of art created in any medium is acceptable for submission.

Colors influence our thoughts, moods, and behaviors. As one of the first chosen components in creating art by artists, colors are everywhere in our lives, and some believe they have the power to heal or destroy.

For Colorium 2026, we encourage artists to submit their finest representational or abstract art in any 2D or 3D mediums, as each real or imaginary art is a presentation of color. 

View last year's exhibition: https://www.gallerium.art/colorium-2025 

Submission is free, and a fixed fee applies to selected artists only.

Submit now to Colorium 2026 and add your voice to this chromatic celebration of art and meaning.

items.name: SELF — self portraits that go beyond likeness
items.shortDescription:
SELF

Self portraits that go beyond likeness

Juror: Douglas Beasley

 ​SELF is a call for self portraits that go beyond likeness — images made in the act of looking at oneself honestly, uncomfortably, tenderly, or strangely. We're not looking for vanity or performance. We're looking for the photographs that came out of a real reckoning: with a body, a memory, a loss, a transformation, a question you couldn't answer any other way.

The self portrait is one of photography's oldest and most exposed forms. The camera becomes both mirror and confessional — there is no subject to direct, no one else to blame for what appears. What's left is just you, deciding what to reveal and what to withhold.

​$1,000 Cash Awards

items.name: South Street Art Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
We invite you to apply to the 13th Annual South Street Art Festival!

South Street Art Festival is a three-day outdoor art festival held in the heart of Downtown Arlington, Texas.
Knowledgeable art loving attendees fill the streets seeing booth after booth of quality art from local, regional and national artists on April 9, 10, 11, 2027.

South Street Art Festival is the longest running and only fine art festival in the Downtown Cultural Art District of Arlington, TX.  In addition to the quality art, patrons can enjoy live entertainment from local and regional bands performing all weekend, creating a well rounded event for all to enjoy.

items.name: Soirée 2027
items.shortDescription: The Soirée is the City of Anderson’s signature two-day arts festival, celebrating the best of visual art, live music and performances, and local food. Enjoy performances across multiple stages, browse unique artisan vendors, experience chef-driven culinary offerings, and explore a dedicated kids’ area filled with hands-on activities. Each year, thousands gather in the heart of Anderson to celebrate creativity, community, and culture—and we can’t wait to welcome you.

items.name: St. Charles Fine Art Show 2027
items.shortDescription:
Calling All Artists!
Be part of the celebrated St. Charles Fine Art Show on May 29th & May 30th, 2027.  The St. Charles Fine Art Show, marking its 29th year, invites over 100 juried artists to showcase their original works across various mediums.  Held outdoors along the scenic Fox River in downtown St. Charles, this event promises a vibrant atmosphere and a prime opportunity to connect with art enthusiasts and buyers.
  • High Visibility: Attracting over 20,000 attendees in 2026, the show offers unparalleled exposure to art lovers and serious buyers
  • Proven Success: Artists have reported outstanding sales, making this a fantastic start to the art season
  • Community & Support: Join a community supported by over 80 volunteers and hundreds of art supporters
  • Marketing Efforts: In 2026, our marketing efforts reached over 80,000 users on social media
  • Exclusive Perks: Supporters who purchase $250 worth of art at the show receive two free tickets to the Arcada Theater
Experience St. Charles
St. Charles is known for its passionate art community-- evident from ample public art around town, exceptional galleries and first class theaters and also has numerous authentic dining experiences, a vibrant nightlife and an array of scenic recreation, making it a destination that attracts visitors from across the country.
Embrace this opportunity to showcase your work, connect with fellow artists and enjoy the thriving culture of St. Charles.

items.name: Savannah Craft on the River Art Market 2027 (April) Rousakis Riverfront Plaza
items.shortDescription:
Crafts on the River — Savannah, Georgia

Join us for Crafts on the River, a distinctive outdoor arts and crafts market held along Savannah’s historic riverfront at Rousakis Riverfront Plaza.

Set in the heart of one of the Southeast’s most visited destinations, Crafts on the River brings together talented artists, craftspeople, makers, and creative entrepreneurs for a weekend of original art, handcrafted work, and direct connection with the public.

Savannah’s River Street provides a setting unlike almost any other. With its historic architecture, cobblestone streets, hotels, restaurants, shops, river traffic, and steady flow of visitors, the waterfront creates a natural marketplace where artists can meet customers from Savannah and from across the country.

Crafts on the River is about the people who make the work. We are looking for artists and craftspeople who create, design, and produce what they sell. The event emphasizes handmade work, originality, quality, and the opportunity for customers to meet the individuals behind the work.

Our goal is simple: create a professionally managed waterfront marketplace where artists can sell their work, visitors can discover something they won’t find everywhere else, and Savannah’s creative community remains an important part of the River Street experience.

Bring your work. Meet the public. Spend the weekend on the river.

Welcome to Crafts on the River.

items.name: Art in The Loop 2027
items.shortDescription:
Art Works Foundation announces its 10th annual edition of Art in The Loop, an Art Festival in Memphis, TN, Friday, April 9th – Sunday, April 11th, 2027.

Art in The Loop will be staged in east Memphis, near Poplar & I-240, on Ridgeway Loop Road. This unique site is situated in between 1.5 million square feet of high level offices and one of Memphis' most exclusive residential areas (the founder of AutoZone lives right around the corner; so, too, did the late founder of FeEx).  In addition to offices, the area boasts several hotels (including the Memphis Hilton) and a 4 screen Cinema dedicated to films attractive to the over 45 audiences; there are also two Mega-Churches in view of our festival site, which bring additional traffic on Sunday.  Our Sponsors include: WKNO TV & FM, the local PBS & NPR Affiliates & Memphis Magazine.

"Art in The Loop was one of the best to participate in for being the most thoughtful, and on top of that, one of the most profitable! This is a magic unicorn show!"  Yvonne Miller, Mixed Media Artist Atlanta GA.


For more about ArtWorks Foundation and more Artists' views, see - https://www.artworks.foundation/
For more about this show, see -http://www.artintheloop.org/

items.name: Savannah River Street Art Market 2027 (February 26-27-28) Rousakis Riverfront Plaza
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the Savannah River Street Art Market, An outdoor art and fine craft market set along Savannah's world-famous riverfront.

Nestled beside the scenic Savannah River, this event will bring together a carefully curated collection of artists, makers, and specialty vendors in one of the Southeast's most visited destinations. Surrounded by historic architecture, waterfront views, restaurants, hotels, and shops, exhibitors will have the opportunity to engage with both Savannah residents and the thousands of visitors who flock to the city each holiday weekend.

The Savannah Riverfront is one of the city's premier attractions, drawing travelers from across the country who come to experience Savannah's unique blend of history, culture, hospitality, and Southern charm. The Savannah River Street Art Market is designed to create an enjoyable shopping experience while providing artists with strong exposure in a highly walkable, destination-oriented setting.

Be among the first exhibitors to help establish what promises to become a new Labor Day weekend tradition on Savannah's historic waterfront. We look forward to welcoming you to the inaugural Savannah Riverside Market.

Festival Hours: Friday 09/04 10 AM - 6 PM, Saturday 09/05 10AM - 6 PM, Sunday 09/06 10AM - 4PM, Monday 09/07 10AM - 4PM (allowed to stay late)

items.name: Laguna Art-A-Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
Laguna Art-A-Fair is a premier fine art festival nestled in a scenic canyon in Laguna Beach, California. For nine weeks each summer, the festival brings together a vibrant community of artists, artisans, art enthusiasts, and visitors in a unique outdoor setting beneath covered exhibit areas.
Art-A-Fair is a cooperative community of independent artists from across the United States and around the world. The festival showcases award-winning artists and artisans whose work represents a diverse range of artistic styles and mediums.
Two-dimensional artwork includes oil, acrylic, watercolor, mixed media, encaustic, pastel, charcoal, colored pencil, photography, and printmaking. Three-dimensional artwork includes jewelry, ceramics, glass, mirrors, fiber art, woodcraft, sculpture, gourds, and more.
Open to the public seven days a week, Art-A-Fair offers visitors an opportunity to explore exceptional artwork, meet the artists, and enjoy the creative energy of the festival. Weekend visitors can also enjoy live local music, while the on-site restaurant and bar provide delicious food and beverages in a charming outdoor setting featuring a beautiful waterfall.
Laguna Art-A-Fair welcomes artists and visitors alike to experience one of Southern California's most distinctive summer art destinations.

items.name: Orange Beach Seafood Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 2027 Orange Beach Seafood Festival will be held at the Wharf on Saturday, February 27th from 10 a.m. - 4 p.m. The festival is the major fundraising event for the Makos Academics Arts & Athletics Club (MAAAC), which directly benefits Orange Beach schools. Each year, more than 20,000 people attend this one-day fundraising event.

The annual festival features a full day of delicious food, 75+ artists/crafters from throughout the South, and music for the whole family to enjoy. In addition, there is a large Kids' Zone with activities, and a huge car show - featuring antique, classic and hot rod vehicles all along Main Street.  There is no admission charge to the event and plenty of parking. Volunteers from Orange Beach schools help park cars and donations are accepted in support of our schools. 

Find more information on MAAAC, please visit:  https://www.obmaaac.org

items.name: Englewood Invitational Spring Art Festival 2027
items.shortDescription: Thousands of art lovers have flocked to the Englewood Invitational Spring Art Festival for over 39 years to shop for unique handmade fine arts and fine crafts.  Artist Run and Artist Friendly, the Englewood Invitational is in the wealthy Englewood/Boca Grande community which is growing daily with sophisticated new homeowners and art buyers looking to add new work to their art collections and decorate their new homes.  The fabulous location on the spacious grounds of a private club in downtown Englewood has great visibility and traffic, lots of room, onsite parking for artists and patrons, easy load and unload and back of booth art storage.  The quality of our 100 exhibitors and extensive regional marketing makes our show a fun and profitable event for everyone.

items.name: Art in the Village 2027 - Carlsbad
items.shortDescription:
For nearly three decades, the Carlsbad Village Association has hosted Art in the Village, a free, one-day, open-air art show, that features the extraordinary work of fine artists from all over the region. The 2026 event brought together over 150 local and regional fine artists and musicians for a festive day of visual and performing arts.

Celebrating the dynamic fine art culture in Carlsbad Village and the surrounding areas, the event attracts thousands of residents and travelers by offering a diverse selection of fine artists in media such as painting (oil, acrylic, watercolor), classical and contemporary sculpture, glass, drawing, photography, metal, digital art, printmaking, wood, fiber, and mixed media.

Starting at 10AM attendees browse exhibiting artist booths, watch performance art, enjoy interactive demos, and listen to live music along State Street and Grand Avenue right in the heart of downtown Carlsbad Village. Carlsbad Village features charming streets filled with shops, cafes, and restaurants, making it the perfect setting for a day of art and culture.

items.name: Brookside Art Annual 2027
items.shortDescription: The Brookside Art Annual is celebrating its 41st year. Located in a vibrant neighborhood in the center of Kansas City, Brookside is just minutes from downtown, the Plaza and the southern suburbs. As the first art show of the year Brookside becomes the center of the midwest art community each May! The focus of the show is on ART and this community loves art shows, and is consistently ranked in the top 25 shows according to Art Source. Art Source quote "This is a very pleasant, national caliber event attracting an affluent, enthusiastic and knowledgeable clientele.”

items.name: Old Town Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Old Town Art Fair will take place on June 12-13, 2027, on the streets of the historic Old Town Triangle neighborhood on Chicago’s near north side.

The Old Town Art Fair is considered one of the top outdoor fine art shows in the nation. Celebrated for over 75 years, the fair will once again line the streets of the historic Old Town Triangle neighborhood on Chicago’s near north side, amid charming homes, leafy parkways, and welcoming neighbors.

A distinguishing feature of the Old Town Art Fair is its all-volunteer management. The show succeeds thanks in no small part to the tireless efforts of as many as 750 unpaid volunteers - your partners in this great event! Fair proceeds support nonprofit organizations such as the Menomonee Boys and Girls Club, local schools, community groups and neighborhood improvements.

This is a show for artists and art buyers alike -- our art patrons are considered to be discerning, art-educated, and loyal art buyers. We continue to place a strong emphasis on increasing our marketing profile to bring more buyers to you in a unique direct-to-consumer sales model.

The volunteer-led Old Town Art Fair is committed to providing the highest quality experience possible for both our artists and our patrons. The Fair is produced by the Old Town Triangle Association, a nonprofit neighborhood organization whose Director also serves as staff support to the Fair.

We invite you to apply for one of our highly coveted artist spots!

items.name: Deep Ellum Community Arts Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 5th Annual Deep Ellum Community Arts Fair is a community-driven 3-day event taking place the first weekend in April. Attendees have the chance to explore the vibrant and eclectic culture of Deep Ellum while supporting local and regional artists. 

We invite artists of every medium to apply. Preference is given to local and greater Texas-based artists first. Artists from further away will be considerd upon demonstrating a meaningful connection to Deep Ellum.  

By the Deep Ellum commUNITY for the Deep Ellum commUNITY:

The most exciting part of this event is that it is all grassroots—wanted and created by the Deep Ellum Community. We honor the Deep Ellum Arts Festival that took place for nearly 30 years, while holding space for artists within our community. Working with the neighborhood, this event highlights the small businesses and local talent who make Deep Ellum the Soul of Dallas.

This locally-produced event celebrates the artists who help define Deep Ellum as a creative and cultural hub, while welcoming artists from near and far away.

items.name: Downtown Delray Art Festival on 4th, 26th Annual Howard Alan Events December 2026
items.shortDescription: The event kicks off at the intersection of E Atlantic Ave and NE 4th Ave, right in the center of downtown. It will move north along NE 4th Ave for two complete blocks until reaching NE 2nd St. Additionally, the event will span east and west across 4th Ave on NE 1st St. This prime location is nestled among excellent shops, wonderful dining options, and a vibrant artistic community. The show is closed. All applications will be juried for wait list only.

items.name: Call for Art - Olympia Art Crossing Project
items.shortDescription:
The City of Olympia is seeking an artist or artist team to develop site-specific artwork for each of two projects as part of the Olympia Art Crossings Project. Olympia Crossings: An Art Plan for City Gateways identifies eight locations for public art along civic boulevards. This solicitation is for Art Crossing #4 – Harrison/Division and Art Crossing #5 – Henderson/Eskridge. These locations are based in neighborhoods and mark primary gateways approximately one mile from the center of downtown Olympia.

Applicants must identify Art Crossing #4 or Art Crossing #5 as their preference, and indicate willingness to be considered for the second location. Projects will be awarded to two separate artists/teams. Budget is $55,000 per project.

See full application at www.olympiawa.gov/art-crossing-call

This project is supported in part by an award from the National Endowment for the Arts.

items.name: City of Santa Rosa Public Art Walk 2027 - 2029
items.shortDescription: The City of Santa Rosa Public Art Program is excited to announce a call for up to 10 temporary outdoor art installations for the 2027- 2029 Santa Rosa Public Art Walk, themed, Inspired by.... This initiative aims to transform our downtown into a vibrant, open-air gallery that celebrates creativity and sparks imagination.
